Family slots carry the LIVE shipped stacks (global.css @theme + @font-face, the rendering truth: zero visual change law) for the six live slots, plus the two canon slots (title/code) the packages/ui components consume. FILED CONTRADICTION (S2, unresolved — AK decision needed): canon locks Body = Crimson Pro (typography.tokens.json; color.md Decision 7c) but the live app ships --font-body = Inter and never loads Crimson Pro; canon mandates self-hosted WOFF2 (fonts.md 'NO runtime CDN') but the live app loads OFL families from the Google Fonts CDN. Neither side is silently 'fixed' here — the live values are transcribed and the conflict is recorded.
